title: The Orrery
description: A mountaintop observatory and the brass model of the sky it keeps,
drawn the way the model works: one sun of brass, four planets wired
in close, six bodies on the outer ring, seven stars of the Plough
that only appear as the previous one is found, and a crank nobody
has turned in years because the sky turns first.
This group is the canvas's own exhibit: every line form, arrowhead,
arrow placement, dash pattern and weight the format has, two
extremes of `bend`, anchored and split-line approaches, a chapter
whose own `dependencyStyle` sets the orbital default, a 288-pixel
sun with the icon drawn small inside it, seven 16-pixel stars with
the icon drawn corner to corner, a turned gear, a hidden line, and
a planet whose lines are deliberately not drawn at all.
